attributes.context: This is proposed as new Section 9.8.5, titled Self-Checkout, in the recommended settlement changes between UFCW locals and Safeway Inc., addressing employer discretion to use one self-checkout stand per store and required negotiation over effects if a second self-checkout stand is introduced.

extraction_text: The Employer may have, at its discretion, a multi-unit self-checkout check stand per store. If the Employer wants to introduce a second multi-unit self-checkout check stand, the parties agree to negotiate over the effects of the introduction of a second unit.
